definitions.explanation: The physical body of a person or animal. Used when talking about health, physical conditions, or body-related topics.
Often used idiomatically to refer to one's health or physical well-being, as in {体|からだ}に{気|き}をつける (take care of your health).

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You have a big body, don't you?

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take care of yourself (your health).
examples.notes: A common phrase used when parting or showing concern

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is your body okay? (Are you feeling alright?)

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{体|からだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's important to move your body every day.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れている→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: When your body is tired, it's better to go to bed early.

notes:
{体|からだ} is a fundamental word referring to the physical body and by extension one's health or physical condition.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {体|からだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to take care of one's health
- {体|からだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧: to move one's body, to exercise
- {体|からだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧: to ruin one's health
- {体|からだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧: one's physical condition

KANJI READING:
The kanji {体|からだ} is also read as たい in compounds:
- ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧: physical education
- ⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧: body weight
- ⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧: body temperature

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{身体|しんたい}→身体：03330_shintai⟧: body (more formal/literary)
- ⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧: physical body (emphasizes flesh)
